tensions.title: Type scale is ad-hoc
tensions.body: 59.96px → 20px on the listing (ratio ≈3.0), no intermediate level. Direct will need to decide whether the target adopts a modular scale.

tensions.title: Only one logo variant captured
tensions.body: The brand is a text wordmark (synthesized from header .nav-title); there is no image logo, monochrome or inverted variant. Direct should plan a mark set if one is needed.

tensions.title: Several palette colors used in only one context
tensions.body: #0076df (primary) as text only — never a fill or border; #7a7a7a (text-muted) text only; #477dca (accent-2) hover text only; #fafafa (surface) background only. Direct will need to decide: drop, expand, or keep as accents.

tensions.title: 100% of images carry empty alt text
tensions.body: 5 of 5 images (the header social icons) have alt="" — each link carries an aria-label, so they are decorative; still a content-sourcing decision for direct.

tensions.title: Muted grey fails WCAG AA
tensions.body: #7a7a7a is 4.29:1 on #fff and 4.11:1 on the #fafafa footer (dates, read time, footer); footer text renders ~9.9px at 360px. Lighthouse 2026-10-13 flagged both.
